prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as each has only 1 test.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -6.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, hint] adoption_photo_troubleshooting_tips: Displays helpful tips on photo quality and lighting directly on the upload photos screen. (why: Support mail logged 3 issues regarding custom pet creation failing or producing distorted visual results.)
1: [home, new_screen] waiting_interactive_activity_screen: Adds a dedicated interactive activity screen during pet generation so users have engaging content while waiting. (why: The waiting step (home target) has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs while waiting.)
2: [finish, layout] home_intro_interaction_overview: Changes the home intro layout to a split screen highlighting fundamental pet controls and navigation. (why: Support received 3 complaints from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_story_scroll_redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a story scroll layout showing path options seamlessly. (why: The choose_path step takes a high mean time of 514s with a 23.8% drop-off rate.)
4: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_carousel_redesign: Redesigns the friend selection step into an interactive carousel layout for browsing pet choices. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s).)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] new_welcome_overview_screen: Adds a new welcome orientation screen right before story setup to guide first-time users. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%, with early churn on initial path selection.)
6: [home, new_flow] waiting_status_notification_flow: Enables desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen when pet generation finishes. (why: Long wait times on the waiting step cause users to switch windows and miss when their pet is ready.)
7: [finish, new_screen] finish_desktop_display_troubleshooter_screen: Adds a final screen offering visibility check instructions if the pet fails to render on the desktop. (why: Support mail logged 3 tickets where pets did not appear on the desktop or the app failed to open properly.)
8: [choose_path, wait_info] choose_path_time_estimate: Displays a time estimate indicator on the choose_path screen to reassure users about onboarding duration. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating hesitation due to unknown time commitment.)

scores.note: Addresses highest drop-off step (adoption 39.1%) with both funnel data and 3 support tickets.
New screen requires major dev effort; home step drop-off is relatively low (18.7%) with no support mail.
Targets finish step (35.2% drop-off) supported by 3 user complaints regarding post-onboarding confusion.
Redesign on choose_path; evidence limited to high mean duration with no support complaints, redesigns unproven.
Targets adoption (lowest conversion 60.9%), but relies on redesign which has shown weak results so far.
Adds a new screen prior to choose_path; costly to build with low confidence from prior new_screen tests.
New flow targeted at home step wait times; new_flow changes have shown no clear positive effect.
Strong evidence from 3 support tickets on finish step, but adding a screen is high cost and unproven.
Low cost UI addition to address high mean time on choose_path step, though drop-off impact is moderate.
